reason: Entries: next_col is reached by BEQ (count 0) and fall-through from BNE byte; both go to the unchanged LDY #1 / LDA (p_ptr),Y, so A=count, Y=1 in both. Old: SEC/ADC #1 gives count+2 (carry lost by CLC), then ADC p_ptr with C=0. New: INC A gives count+1, SEC/ADC p_ptr gives p_ptr+count+2. For count<=253 A and C (into BCC same_page) are identical; at count=254 the new code is right where the old was wrong, at 255 both wrong; straight sprite column counts are small (image is 12 cols, rows bounded). Y=1 both, X untouched, no memory difference, stack unchanged. N/Z overwritten (STA keeps them but INC sky_c/LDA/CMP rewrite before BEQ). V differs (count+1 + p_ptr + 1 vs count+2 + p_ptr) and reaches RTS via built -> sky_image's JMP tail -> sky.6502 .draw, but sky_draw rewrites V with ADC sky_j8 etc. before any use; the only BVC in sky code (sky_off) is preceded by its own BIT. D is clear in play (both forms would be equally affected anyway). Interrupts see no different memory or stack. Cycles: old SEC 2 + ADC# 2 + CLC 2 + ADC zp 3 = 9, new INC A 2 + SEC 2 + ADC zp 3 = 7: 2 saved. Bytes: old 1+2+1+2=6, new 1+1+2=4: 2 saved (the claim's 1 understates it).
